sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your counter-offer and are willing to extend the contract term to 24 months to provide you with long-term stability. For our main proposal, we present a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

However, we must maintain our 30-day payment terms to manage our operational costs effectively. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Therefore, we can also offer an option with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. It is always a pleasure working alongside your valued company.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
As we have already made concessions to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms, we cannot reduce our price further.
We must therefore maintain our offer of €52.20 per unit for these terms, and we rely on our long-standing relationship to reach a mutual understanding.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to do business with our respected neighbors in the region, and our long-standing relationship with your house means a great deal to us here at our family-run foundry. We have carefully reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.

We have already made significant concessions by accepting your requested 60-day payment terms and 24-month contract duration. Therefore, we must firmly hold our offer at €52.20 per unit and expect a realistic step forward from your side. 

For clarity, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We take immense pride in the craftsmanship of our workforce and the quality we deliver to your operations, and we trust we can find a good path forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
